claims.claim: Blue motorcycle is MX X100 (as shown).
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies brand/model from photo 1 (read_from: photo 1).

claims.claim: It is 'okay' and 'buy and drive to any location'.
claims.evidence: Photos show appearance only; no evidence of starting, riding test, or functional checks (lights/indicators/horn/brakes).
No photo/clip shows brake operation, lever feel, or gear engagement.
Photos show some dirt/wear; rust status on hidden metal areas (frame, tank, fasteners) is not shown.
Photos do not confirm originality of internal parts or replacement components.
No receipt/registration or odometer proof shown.
Photos do not clearly show battery condition or whether it is present and working.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have low compression; witness photos don’t show starting/compression/smoke/leaks.
risks.proof: Short video: cold start + 2–3 minutes idle, then quick throttle; show no unusual smoke and no fuel/oil leaks under the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-verified running condition unit (assume may need engine work).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or worn (pads/shoes, brake fluid/lines) even if visually intact.
risks.proof: Clip: front and rear brake test—hard stop from low speed (or static lever pressure test) showing strong bite; show brake fluid/line condition if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not guaranteed (assume service/parts may be needed).

risks.risk: Electricals may fail (headlight, indicators, horn, tail light) or battery may be dead.
risks.proof: Photo/video: turn on ignition and demonstrate headlight, both indicators, horn, brake light, and tail light; show battery voltage reading if possible.

risks.risk: Tires may be near-worn or have sidewall cracks; photos don’t provide tread depth or crack inspection.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of both tires: tread depth view + sidewall crack check + front/rear tire age markings if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Chassis/frame may be bent or previously crashed; photos don’t confirm straightness.
risks.proof: Video: straight-line check from multiple angles (front wheel alignment, fork straightness) and underside/frame inspection for bends.

risks.risk: Ownership/registration/document mismatch could make it hard to transfer or may indicate stolen goods.
risks.proof: Clear photos of receipt, VIN/chassis number plate, and current registration/roadworthiness documents; show VIN matches the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documents not verified (buyer risk).

risks.risk: Fuel system issues (rusty tank, dirty carb, clogged jets) may cause poor running.
risks.proof: Clip: after start, show smooth idle and throttle response; ask for carb/tank inspection photo (tank interior if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fuel system condition uncertain.

proof_requests: Video of cold start and 2–3 minutes idle + throttle response (no smoke/leaks).
Demonstration video of headlight, indicators, horn, brake light, and tail light working.
Close-up photos of front and rear tires (tread depth and sidewall cracks).
Brake test video (front + rear) showing strong stopping power.
Photos of battery (present) and a battery voltage reading if possible.
Photos of VIN/chassis number plate and receipt/registration documents showing match and status.
response.reason: The witness can identify the motorcycle visually, but key value drivers for a buyer in Oyo—starting/running, brakes, electricals, tires, and documents—are not shown in the report. Without those proof points, a safe worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
